title: Can I Beat the HARDEST Drawback?
summary: Drawback Chess with 'hard drawbacks' enabled: tries to win five games vs online humans while saddled with brutal handicaps like Winds of Fate. Wins 5 games; final discussion is about the Ichthyophobe drawback.
rules: Standard setup; each player gets one secret random drawback (with hard drawbacks enabled); opponent's drawback is revealed after the game.
No check/checkmate: kings can be captured; moving into check is legal; capturing the enemy king wins.
If your drawback makes you have no legal moves / you violate a lose-condition drawback, you lose.
The site highlights moves your drawback requires.

Drawbacks seen: Winds of Fate (every turn you are randomly unable to move either left or right), Lame Duck (you can't move your king), Stand Your Ground (your pieces can only capture if they are attacked); Ichthyophobe (discussed at the end as the 'hardest' drawback; exact text not captured).
win_condition: Capture the enemy king / opponent loses via drawback. Video goal: 5 wins.
